"''No worries, Windy.|Windy and Luke Skywalker|}} '''Windy''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who was a [[Youngling|childhood]] friend of [[Luke Skywalker]], a [[moisture farmer]] from [[Tatooine]] who later joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]]. Other members of this circle of friends included [[Biggs Darklighter]], [[Camie Marstrap]], [[Deak]], and [[Laze Loneozner]]. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] once rescued both Windy and 12-[[Standard year|year]]-old Skywalker from a [[krayt dragon]] after discovering the two unconscious in a [[sandstorm]].''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' ==Behind the scenes== The character of Windy first appeared in some of the earliest drafts for ''[[Star Wars]]''.[[The Star Wars rough draft|''The Star Wars'' rough draft]] The character did not make the cut of the final film of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], but appeared in deleted scenes{{Film|IV}} and appeared in a number of [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] stories, variously as Windom Marstrap and Windy Starkiller.{{StoryCite|story=Luke Skywalker's Walkabout|book=Dark Horse Presents Annual 1999: DHP Jr.}} The character also appears in [[Star Wars (LINE Webtoon)|''Star Wars'' LINE Webtoon]], but the Webtoon comic falls into a [[canon]] "grey area" as the comic was allowed to have cultural interpretation.{{Twitter|jenniferheddle|status/604430151309365249|[[Jennifer Heddle]]|quote=It is approved but its canon status is grey area. We gave them leeway for cultural interpretation|archivefile=File:LINE Webtoon Tweet.png}} The events of the comic were referenced in the [[2018]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'', but says that Windy was aged twelve, whereas the comic states he was thirteen. ==Appearances== *[[Star Wars (LINE Webtoon)|''Star Wars'' LINE Webtoon]] {{1st}} *{{Film|IV}} {{Del}} *''[[A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy]]'' {{Ab|A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy (audiobook)}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[Disney Magic Kingdoms]]'' {{Mo}} ==Sources== *{{BuildFalconCite|21|Starship Fact File}} {{1stm}} {{SourceContents|issue={{HelmetCollectionCite|66|parent=1}}|contents= *{{HelmetCollectionCite|66|Helmets}} {{Imo}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|66|Weapons & Uniforms}} {{Imo}} }} *[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Windy |ja=ウィンディ |ka=უინდი |pl=Windy }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Tatooinians]]
